Job Description 
 About the Team  

 The AV Launch team builds the software foundation that brings GM’s autonomous   driving capabilities to life on the vehicle. We configure, deploy, launch, and   monitor   the applications that make up the   autonomy   stack, developing onboard services that orchestrate vehicle activities from startup through shutdown.   
 

 We are part of GM’s Autonomous Vehicle Platform Core team, delivering the core software frameworks that   enable other teams and major vehicle systems. We own critical platform capabilities that include   software deployment, application configuration and lifecycle management, vehicle power and software   modes, and   observability systems.   
 

 Our systems   span   embedded   vehicle platforms, manufacturing lines, developer infrastructure, cloud services, and simulation.   We   support   internal data collection fleets and production vehicles , and partner closely with platform teams and autonomy developers to solve complex problems.   

 
 About the Role  

 As an early career Software Engineer on the AV Launch team, you will design, implement, test, and   operate   the services that reliably manage autonomous driving software on GM vehicles. You will work across the software lifecycle: from   understanding   requirements and defining platform behavior to building production-quality services, integrating with vehicle hardware,   validating   behavior on benches and vehicles, and diagnosing issues in real-world environments.   
 

 This role is designed for a recent graduate or engineer early in their career who wants to build depth in embedded systems, distributed software, vehicle platforms, and autonomous driving technology. You will learn from experienced engineers while contributing meaningful code to systems that must be dependable, observable, and maintainable.   
 

 You will develop a systems-level perspective as you learn how individual services, devices, and vehicle states interact.   Over time , you will turn that understanding into clear abstractions and design   guidance that inform how other developers   build vehicle software .   

 
   What   You’ll   Do    

 Build on-vehicle services that   provision,   launch , and   monitor   autonomous vehicle software in development and production workflows.   

 
 Build frameworks to configure autonomy software for a wide variety of hardware platforms, simulation environments, and use cases.   

 
 Develop systems and frameworks to   monitor   vehicle status and   reliability .   

 
 Work alongside experienced engineers to ramp up on AV software, embedded systems, and the production engineering practices required to support autonomous driving at scale.   

 
 Grow through progressively more complex assignments spanning design, implementation, integration, and testing.   

 
 
 Required Qualifications 

 Recently completed a bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD degree in a STEM field.   For completed degrees, graduation must have occurred within the past 9 months.   

 
 Strong background in C++ and Python development,   demonstrated   through coursework, internships, research, or   substantial   projects.   

 
 Experience developing in a Linux environment.   

 

 Strong grasp of software fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, operating systems , concurrency,   and computer architecture.   

 
 Ability to debug complex software problems, reason   about   system behavior, and communicate clearly in a collaborative team environment.   

 
 Interest   in autonomous vehicles, robotics, embedded systems, or   high-performance   software.   

 
 Preferred Qualifications  

 Familiarity with   robotics   middleware platforms and related concepts, such as inter-process communication or logging.   
 
 Prior   internship, research, or project experience in autonomous driving, robotics, embedded systems, AI/ML infrastructure, or platform software.   
 Graduation between December 2025 and August 2026, with availability to begin employment in 2026. 
 
 Location: 
 This role is categorized as hybrid . This means the selected candidate is expected to report to our Sunnyvale, CA office location at least 3 times a week.
 This job may be eligible for relocation benefits
 
 
 Compensation:   The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. It is based on what a successful applicant might be paid in accordance with applicable state laws. The compensation may not be representative for positions located outside of New York, Colorado, California, or Washington.
 The salary range for this role   :   is $119,250 to $153,900. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.
 Bonus Potential:  An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance.
 





 About GM 
 Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.
 
 Why Join Us  
 We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team.
 
 Benefits Overview 
 From day one, we're looking out for your well-being–at work and at home–so you can focus on realizing your ambitions. Learn how GM supports a rewarding career that rewards you personally by visiting Total Rewards resources .
 
 Non-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities (U.S.) 
 General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. We strongly believe that providing an inclusive workplace creates an environment in which our employees can thrive and develop better products for our customers.
 
 All employment decisions are made on a non-discriminatory basis without regard to sex, race, color, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran or protected veteran, or any other similarly protected status in accordance with federal, state and local laws. 
 
 We encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for any positions that match their skills and capabilities. Applicants in the recruitment process may be required, where applicable, to successfully complete a role-related assessment(s) and/or a pre-employment screening prior to beginning employment. To learn more, visit How we Hire .
 
 Accommodations 
 General Motors offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us or call us at 1-800-865-7580. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.
